Quick answers inline to your numbered questions and a couple of extra notes: 

1) PHI & caching: we will only enable prefix/KV caching for tokens that are explicitly identified as non-PHI by your input routing rules (example: common product descriptions, knowledge-base snippets). We will provide a config flag so your integration can mark fields as non-cachable. No user-identifying strings will be written to the persistent cache.

2) Latency under burst: dynamic batching groups requests arriving within a 15–35ms micro-window when feasible. In our simulation (attached), the 95th percentile additional latency from batching under 2x bursts was ~82ms — still within your 650ms SLO in our runs. If you need stricter latency, we can set an interactive route that disables batching and relies on reserved capacity (costs go up ~32%).

3) SOC2: attaching our standard SOC2 + evidence pack link. We will also provide request-level audit logs for the pilot period.
